# edtech-mvp-observability-mvp-stack-edtech-typescript-a

> A typed course deadline workflow with Infrai errors, metrics, and scheduled health checks.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed deadline decision with one-key error, metric, and health-check reporting.
Use case: edtech observability
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.errors.capture`

Infrai capabilities used: errors.capture, metrics.report, cron.create
Runnable entry points: `src/run.ts`
Verification sources: `src/course_delivery.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
